warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.50 + 3.00 (6.50); y = A-B-C-D-E at 3.50 + 4.00 + 2.00 + 3.50 (13.00). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-03 and (A-D only, 9.50) S-04. Positions were checked against the PDF's own vector geometry (beam faces sit 0.10 either side of every grid line at 1:75) as well as the printed numbers.

Every tick of every grid-marked x/y chain is a line (section 4 rule 4): 18 x dummies and 11 y dummies. Dummy names follow position order, so the 10 dummies between 2 and 3 run 2' (4.50) to 2'''''''''' (6.10), and the y dummies before A share A's sequence: A' (-2.00), A'' (-0.35), A''' (-0.20), then A'''' (0.30), A''''' (1.60), A'''''' (1.70).

Pairs exactly 0.05 apart kept as separate lines because they are different printed points: 2' (4.50, rafter on S-04) vs 2'' (4.55, S2 ledge edge on S-03); 2'''''''' (5.50, rafter) vs 2''''''''' (5.55, ledge edge); A''''' (1.60, S-03 beam) vs A'''''' (1.70, S-02 beam). They are not the same edge printed twice.

The S-02 notch beams around the two pipe shafts sit on printed ticks 2'''''''''' (6.10), A'''' (0.30) and C' (7.95). At C3 the drawn beam centre measures 7.90 (faces 7.80/8.00) against the printed 0.45 tick (7.95); the printed tick was used. Likewise the S-02 beam B3 between B and C is drawn with faces 5.25/5.45 (centre about 5.35) while the chain prints 5.25 (also 1.250 from grid 3 on the S-09 stair plan); the printed 5.25 line was used.

Truss elevation chains (TRUSS T2 on S-04, T3/T4/T5/T6 on S-05) print no grid bubbles — their supports are labelled with truss marks — so they are recorded with edge ends and create no lines. Their sub-totals equal the grid bays (T5/T6 2.00 / 4.00 / 3.50 = D-C / C-B / B-A; T3/T4 panel chain = the S-04 grid-marked rafter chain, whose ticks are lines). T2's 0.583 panels would fall 0.006 / 0.002 from the 1.16 / 2.33 rafter lines.

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนน (A-10 and the A-01 notes). A-10 prints three ระดับหลังคา values, so those ids keep the printed value to stay unique. Beam-top tags (+0.05, +0.10, +0.35, +3.27, +3.45, +3.55) are levels too (legend BX (+X.XX) = แจ้งระดับหลังคาน) and are listed with id null.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-09 plus A-10 (building section, for levels). Footing, beam, slab and stair section dimensions are member detail and stay on their elements. The architectural plans/elevations (A-02..A-09, A-11, A-12) and MEP sheets were not dimension-swept in this op04 pass.
